The test image shows a **leaf** being held up, displaying the underside which has a whitish/grayish coating, with yellow spots visible on upper leaf surfaces. This narrows to the 16 leaf classes.

Top candidates: **Downy_mildew** (tan/gray tufts on underside + yellow spots on upper), **Powdery_Mildew**, **Soybean_rust** (pustules on underside).

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with my top candidates.
This Downy mildew reference matches the setup well - hand holding leaf to show underside, yellow spots on upper surfaces. Let me check another Downy mildew reference.
Good match - yellow spots on leaf surface. Now let me check Powdery_Mildew and Soybean_rust references.
Powdery Mildew shows distinct white circular patches on upper surface - doesn't match test image. Now checking Soybean_rust.
Soybean rust shows many small scattered reddish-brown spots - doesn't match. Now checking Bacterial_Blight.
Bacterial Blight shows angular dark lesions with yellow halos - doesn't match. Checking Frogeye_leaf_spot.
Frogeye shows circular gray spots with dark borders - doesn't match. Checking Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria shows heavy yellowing with dark spots - doesn't match. Checking Bacterial_Pustule.
Bacterial Pustule shows small dark reddish-brown spots - doesn't match. Checking Cercospora.
Cercospora shows dense reddish-purple spots - doesn't match. Checking Sudden_death_syndrome.
SDS shows interveinal chlorosis/necrosis - doesn't match. Checking Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
Vein necrosis shows yellow-orange lesions along veins - doesn't match. Checking Brown_Stem_Rot leaf.
Brown Stem Rot shows severe interveinal necrosis - doesn't match. Checking Phyllosticta_leaf_spot.
Phyllosticta shows large tan necrotic areas - doesn't match. Checking Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus.
Bean Pod Mottle shows green mottling/mosaic - doesn't match. Final view: confirming with third Downy_mildew reference.

This third Downy mildew reference confirms the match: scattered small yellow/light-green spots on upper leaf surfaces, consistent with the test image pattern.

**Summary:**
- Test image: hand holding leaf to show underside (grayish texture = fungal sporulation tufts), scattered small yellow spots on surrounding leaves' upper surfaces
- Downy mildew refs 1 and 3 match precisely: same presentation, same yellow spot pattern, same hand-held leaf showing underside
- All other candidates ruled out: Powdery Mildew (white circular patches), Soybean rust (tiny reddish-brown spots), Bacterial Blight (angular dark lesions with halos), Frogeye (gray spots with dark borders), Septoria (heavy yellowing + dark spots), Cercospora (dense reddish-purple), SDS/BSR (interveinal necrosis), Vein Necrosis (vein-associated lesions), Phyllosticta (large tan areas), Bean Pod Mottle (mottling)
